name: Check my backups ran
description: Checks the newest recent backup file and writes a note saying whether the folder needs attention.
when_to_use: Use it after scheduled backups to spot a folder that has not received a recent file.
goal: Check whether the backups folder has a file newer than two days and save the result.

config.cmd: newest=$(find "$HOME/Backups" -type f -mtime -2 -print -quit); if test -n "$newest"; then printf "A recent backup was found: %s\n" "$newest"; else printf "Alert: backups are stale; check the backup schedule and folder.\n"; fi
